scene: The wound parrot squawks three destinations, sliding back three platform departure doors.
picture: Side view of the repair shop's rear transit bay. On the left, a steel crawler pod rests on tracks. In the centre, the player stands beside the brass parrot on its perch. Up high, a yellow window-cleaner gondola dangles from a hatch. On the right, a red mail train waits with open doors.
shown: a heavy steel crawling pod waiting open on rails at far left
a yellow suspended window-cleaner basket hanging at a hatch up high
a red pneumatic tube mail carriage idling at a platform on right
